notes: Grid is perfectly regular: x=col*48, y=row*48, no gaps, no margins; transparent RGBA PNG. Empty cells: (14,7) and (19,19).
Variants in triplets: dithered hard-edged 256-colour | smooth + dark drop shadow | smooth + white halo. Pick the smooth, non-dithered one that fits your background.

Not in sheet: warning triangle, trophy, joystick/gamepad, game/target/kart/bubble icons. 32px sheet adds red '!' badge docs (rows 14,7-8 / 17,12-16 of 32 grid), tree (10,3), shortcut arrow overlay (9,3), projector screens (20,0-1).
icons32 = best auto-match in WinIcons_32.png (23 cols x 22 rows, 32px cells, no gaps); matchErr < ~20 is reliable. WinIcons_16.png is 23x23 of 16px cells, different order.
